newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE, OFF-BOURSE TRADE NEARLY EQUAL IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE, OFF-BOURSE TRADE NEARLY EQUAL IN JUNE.

text.p: Trade both on and off the bourse during June were at similar levels, the stock exchange said on Friday.
Bourse trade came to 1.179 million lats and while off-bourse activity was 1.189 million lats, the stock exchange said in a statement.
The most traded shares on the bourse were Olainfarm at 344,679 lats, Unibanka at 206,396 lats and Staburadze at 155,058 lats.
Off the market, the most active stocks were Staburadze at 409,180 lats, Unibanka at 307,731 lats and Riga Shipyard at 254,028 lats.
